info.title: Selenium → Playwright AST Migrator
info.description: Agent-assisted AST migration toolkit for moving Selenium tests toward Playwright.

options.name: --mode
options.description: Operation mode.

options.name: --input
options.description: Source, artifact, or project path depending on mode.

options.name: --out
options.description: Output directory inside --workspace by default.

options.name: --workspace
options.description: Migration artifacts root (default: migration).

options.name: --target
options.description: Generation target for migrate/orchestrate.

options.name: --target-test-framework
options.description: Test framework for Playwright .NET output/scaffold/verify defaults.

options.name: --generation-policy
options.description: Controls mapped helper risk: more TODOs, current behavior, or more active code.

options.name: --wizard
options.description: Run init in guided/onboarding mode.

options.name: --fix
options.description: Add safe doctor repair plan artifacts.

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Preview doctor fixes without writing project/config files.

options.name: --apply
options.description: Apply safe doctor fixes inside workspace or .doctor.new config files.

options.name: --source-path
options.description: Source path for direct `init --wizard` form.

options.name: --test-id-attribute
options.description: Default test id attribute for init config.

options.name: --target-project
options.description: Existing target project path for init/discover-target handoff.

options.name: --target-namespace
options.description: Target namespace for init-generated config/scaffold.

options.name: --target-base-class
options.description: Target base class for init-generated config.

options.name: --no-install-kit
options.description: Include or skip lightweight agent loop files during init.

options.name: --source
options.description: Source frontend for source-processing modes.

options.name: --config
options.description: Adapter config layer. Can be repeated.

options.name: --format
options.description: Report format (default: both).

options.name: --ir-version
options.description: IR dump schema for dump-ir.

options.name: --render-ir
options.description: Experimental render input model.

options.name: --validation-mode
options.description: Config validation strictness.

options.name: --recursive-artifacts
options.description: Allow nested artifact lookup where supported.

options.name: --port
options.description: Local report server port for report-serve. Use 0 for static only.

options.name: --static-only
options.description: Generate report-serve static dashboard without starting a server.

options.name: --include-source
options.description: Include source-like files in evidence-pack after explicit review.

options.name: --fail-on-unsupported
options.description: Exit code 2 if unsupported actions exist.

options.name: --fail-on-todo
options.description: Exit code 3 if TODO comments exist.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show global or command-specific help.

options.name: --version
options.description:
Show CLI version metadata and exit.
Exit codes:
0  Success or help shown.
1  User/input error or verification/quality gate failure.
2  Invalid config, invalid source/target/mode, unsupported gate, or preflight failure.
3  TODO quality gate or stage failure.
4  Generated syntax errors detected.
